description: This file defines the Slk class, a specialized reader for SYLK (Symbolic Link) spreadsheet files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to validate, list worksheet info, and load SYLK files into PhpSpreadsheet objects, including processing cell data, styles, formats, and shared styles.

classes.name: Slk
classes.description: A class for reading SYLK (Symbolic Link) spreadsheet files, extending BaseReader, with methods for validation, listing worksheet info, and loading spreadsheets, including processing styles and cell data.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Validates if a file is a SYLK file by checking its headers and content.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Returns worksheet metadata such as name, last column, total rows, and columns based on the SYLK file.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads a SYLK file into a PhpSpreadsheet object.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads a SYLK file into an existing PhpSpreadsheet object, processing cells, styles, and shared style definitions.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the sheet to load from the SYLK file.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current sheet index to load.
